lemma treasury (U : Bid.Dir G c) (P : ChartRatio G) (h : LocalRatio P) (y : AxisChart G F) (hy : y∈parcel F P) :
    toll F P y = |(fderiv ℝ (saver F y) y).det| := by

proof_context.conclusion: At an axial point `y` in the parcel, `toll F P y = |det D(saver F y)(y)|`, i.e. J_ax = |det Ds_y(y)|.

lemma toll_pos {P : ChartRatio G} (h : LocalRatio P) {y : AxisChart G B} (hy : y ∈ parcel B P) :
    0 < toll B P y := Finset.prod_pos (fun i _ => h.pos _ (hy i (mem_univ _)))

proof_context.conclusion: `toll B P y > 0` on the parcel, so J_ax is positive.

lemma certified (t : S.Choices) (h : Shell S t p R (represent x) (abode S F (represent x) a)) :
    let K := damage (helmets _ _ _) (canon S t p R (represent x) (abode S F (represent x) a)) 0
    (hessian F t p R x a).det=(fderiv ℝ (saver F a) a).det^2 * ((rangers F G)ᵀ*K*rangers F G).det := by

proof_context.conclusion: For the stationary point the Hessian determinant factors as `(det D(saver F a) a)^2 * det(rangers^T K rangers)`: the chain rule with the second-derivative term dropped, at the level of determinants.
